args: Why do last week's and this week's 'attributed orders' counts disagree so much?

Last week's channel-revenue report (joined attributions to campaigns) found ~14% order coverage; this week's blind-spot report (just checking attributions.order_id) found ~75-83%. What's driving that gap — is it mostly attribution rows with no campaign_id?
